title: Decadent Chocolate Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F). Grease and line a round baking pan.
In a large bowl, sift together the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add the eggs, milk, and oil. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes until smooth.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a wooden toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let it cool completely before frosting with your favorite chocolate ganache or buttercream.
